objective: Implement pure completed-4H observable adapter and no-observation policy hook with default-disabled shadow integration and synthetic full native parity
summary: Immutable canonical snapshots normalize exact 10-field synthetic primitives and enforce UTC, exact positive 4H duration, finite positive OHLC, non-negative volume, deterministic duplicate/conflict handling and bar-close causal availability. Explicit replay-pair to canonical-symbol mappings bind each exact position to a minimal context. A separate pure policy hook defaults to NO_OBSERVATION. Existing shadow boundaries accept optional policy outputs without changing exit, admission, sizing or capital logic. All 216 synthetic tests and Ruff pass; complete native outputs also match the task-start source for all three supported native-loop policies.
north_star_effect: Advances causal observable input plumbing for the adaptive exit brain without adopting a behavioral predicate, reconstructing historical formulas, changing exits, selecting thresholds or making an economic/production claim.

authority_bindings.canonical_identity_semantics: Prior governed authority only; synthetic in-memory rows implement its schema, no artifact provenance reopened

files.change: Created pure immutable snapshot, normalized collection, causal selector, minimal context, policy bridge and run-local diagnostics adapter
Optional completed-primitive observer at existing position boundaries; shared V1 transition accounting; identity registry cleaned on close
Separately disabled adapter configuration and separate diagnostics sink; existing four-element native return unchanged
Created 101 synthetic-only adapter and replay cases

implementation.normalization: Pure mapping/sequence/dataframe input, exact schema (extra columns rejected), explicit ISO/datetime/Timestamp to UTC, exact positive 4H duration, finite positive OHLC and consistent high/low range, finite non-negative volume, exact non-empty unmodified identities. Sort by symbol and close. Gaps allowed; overlapping same-symbol intervals rejected.
implementation.duplicate_contract: Identical normalized snapshots deduplicate and count. Same identity with different OHLCV/source data raises ConflictingSnapshotError carrying conflicts_rejected=1; nothing is silently selected.
implementation.causal_selection: latest_completed_snapshot_at_or_before selects the exact symbol's latest bar with bar_close_time <= decision_time. Future or unfinished snapshots cannot enter the envelope or policy. None is deterministic unavailability. Exact close is eligible, one nanosecond/second before it is not.
implementation.identity_contract: Replay requires explicit replay-pair -> canonical-symbol bindings; no pair-name conversion, heuristic matching or inference. Existing full per-lifecycle ID is preserved. Prior state must match that exact ID even when no snapshot exists. Repeated/backward adapter boundaries and changed identity context fail closed.
implementation.policy_input: Frozen ObservablePositionContext + one frozen latest completed Observable4HSnapshot + immutable AsyncMemoryState. No native position object, eventual exit, return, PnL, MFE, MAE or future duration is exposed.
implementation.policy_output: None or frozen ObservablePolicyDecision(observation_type=memory|trigger, observed=strict bool). Identity and event time are assigned by the bridge, not the policy. Unsupported outputs fail closed.
implementation.configuration: observable_adapter_enabled=False; enabling requires async_memory_shadow_enabled=True explicitly. Disabled input rows, bindings, policy and diagnostic sink are not consumed/touched.
implementation.event_timestamp: The causal decision boundary, not retrospectively the source bar close. The immutable envelope retains source close and full snapshot identity. A bar completed before admission may be exposed after entry, never used to backdate memory establishment.
replay_order: Existing native shadow boundary first processes explicit externally supplied observations.
Optional observable adapter selects completed primitives for each exact active position and evaluates its policy at the same boundary.
Any returned typed event uses unchanged V1 memory/trigger chronology and duplicate validation. Conflicts with explicit same-boundary observations fail closed.
Native exit evaluation remains in its original order and reads no shadow/adapter result.
Newly admitted positions receive fresh sidecars and adapter observations before their native entry-bar exit evaluation, as in prior shadow integration.
Native close resets and archives the sidecar and removes active identity mappings. Adapter diagnostics retain only the last selection per lifecycle, not per-bar history.
implementation.evaluation_cadence: One selection per active position per hourly replay boundary. The same completed 4H snapshot can be exposed again at later boundaries. No behavioral meaning or deduced predicate is assigned to repetition.
implementation.diagnostic_semantics: Successful runs report conflicts_rejected=0; conflict exceptions carry rejection count without publishing partial replay sinks. Latest completed close is the maximum actually selected close. Unavailable selections do not call the policy. Records contain minimal position context, last snapshot identity or None, and protocol; no economic fields/ranking.
implementation.delegated_control_scope: Existing enabled-shadow rejection for delegated RD26 control remains; no expanded control runtime claims.
